detail: Science Corp raised $400 million in Series D funding at a $3.5 billion valuation to advance its retinal implant and brain-computer interface technologies.
why_relevant: Directly aligned with neural engineering and brain-computer interfaces combining silicon hardware with biomedical signal processing.

detail: Indivi acquired Imperial College spin-out Cogitat to strengthen its AI-driven brain monitoring and electroencephalography analysis capabilities.
why_relevant: Highly relevant for biosignal-ML applications focused on decoding brain activity and digital biomarkers from EEG data.

detail: Researchers developed a magnetic nanoparticle technique to stimulate deep brain regions in Parkinson's models without requiring permanently implanted electrodes.
why_relevant: Pioneers non-invasive neuromodulation techniques translating micro-scale mechanical forces into neural circuit activation.

detail: SpringRA led the FDA authorization for Levo Gen 2, a software-only tinnitus neuromodulation device.
why_relevant: Demonstrates software-as-a-medical-device pathways for auditory neuromodulation and neuro-acoustic therapeutics.

detail: Dreem Health partnered with Withings to integrate wearable health sensor data into its virtual sleep medicine care model.
why_relevant: Bridges consumer wearable biosensors with clinical algorithms for continuous sleep signal processing.

detail: Natural Cycles opened pre-orders for its NC Band 2 wearable featuring overnight temperature biosensing and daytime activity monitoring.
why_relevant: Provides practical context for integrating multi-modal biometric sensors into continuous wearable algorithms.

detail: Sophrosyne Technologies unveiled a custom biomedical sensor chipset designed for wearable health monitoring platforms.
why_relevant: Targeted at hardware-level physiological signal acquisition and low-power wearable sensor design.

detail: Avicenna.AI alongside Bracco secured FDA clearance for AI software capable of detecting CT brain aneurysms.
why_relevant: Applies computer vision and machine learning models to neurovascular imaging and diagnostic decision support.

detail: Perfuze received FDA clearance for its NeuroSheath 8Fr long sheath to complete its stroke thrombectomy system.
why_relevant: Relevant for medical device design within neurovascular stroke care and catheter-based interventions.

detail: AstraNu secured $3.5 million in funding to advance its chip-scale optical imaging technology.
why_relevant: Miniaturized optical imaging micro-systems are key components for next-generation bio-imaging and physiological sensing.

detail: Galvanize Therapeutics raised $130 million in Series D funding to support its pulsed electric field ablation platform.
why_relevant: Applies bioelectric pulses and targeted energy delivery for therapeutic tissue ablation and electrophysiology.

detail: Medtronic received expanded FDA clearance for its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system in general surgery procedures.
why_relevant: Offers core medical device experience in surgical robotics, kinematic control, and real-time intraoperative systems.
